name: Order of the Gauntlet Tournament Field

description.value:
Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Order of the Gauntlet
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 1
Order: Empower

A marked-off field for combat between two armed individuals, with room for spectators. Your hireling is a Knight of your alignment who lodges at the nearest inn or settlement if your Bastion can't house them. The knight isn't a Bastion Defender, but if your Bastion is attacked, they reduce by 1 the number of dice you roll to see how many defenders are lost.

Empower: Hold Tournament. You host a tournament: word takes 7 days to spread to nearby settlements and contestants take 7 more days to arrive and compete. You must spend 2,000 GP on prizes. At its end, your Renown Score with the Order of the Gauntlet increases by 1.

Source: Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn.
